args.title: Fix parseAmount to handle Indian rupee and other currency symbols
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

The parseAmount function should be updated to recognize and handle the Indian rupee sign (₹) and other currency symbols like CHF. This change will prevent amounts with these symbols from being rejected as 'not a number' during imports, improving compatibility.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parseAmount function in src/util/money.ts does not handle the Indian rupee sign (₹) or other currency symbols like CHF. This causes amounts with those symbols to be rejected as 'not a number' in imports, which explains the reported issue.
